queries.causal_trace: rare-earth canonicalizes, but recycling remains a literal application group; the scope allowlist covers only the separations concept, so no entailment can complete the query.
queries.smallest_general_fix: Map resource recycling/recovery directionally into the bounded separation-processing operation family and evaluate program-family coverage.

queries.causal_trace: The exact protected target, solvent-extraction compound, and query-specific scope map align.
queries.smallest_general_fix: Preserve as a positive control.

queries.causal_trace: lanthanide canonicalizes, but ion and exchange are separate literal groups; ion exchange exists only as an evidence alternative and cannot satisfy the scope allowlist.
queries.smallest_general_fix: Recognize ion exchange as an atomic method concept related directionally to separation-processing operations.

queries.causal_trace: REE is protected, but hydrometallurgy is not a separations query form even though it is already present in method evidence vocabulary.
queries.smallest_general_fix: Canonicalize hydrometallurgy as a specialization of extraction, processing, and recovery.

queries.causal_trace: yttrium is accepted as document evidence but is not recognized as a rare-earth query form, so the query never acquires the rare-earth target concept required by the scope entries.

queries.causal_trace: scandium remains literal while recovery canonicalizes; the rare-earth target requirement is therefore absent from scope matching.
queries.smallest_general_fix: Use the same bounded rare-earth-member normalization and family-scope coverage as yttrium.

queries.causal_trace: The rare-earth phrase guard does not accept the separated Earth-observation sense.

queries.causal_trace: Child evidence supplies the complete scientific intent and rolls up correctly.

queries.causal_trace: The guarded catalyst interpretation prevents a platform-name collision.

queries.actual_result: 1 irrelevant cancer candidate; Rural MOMS missed

queries.actual_result: 213 visible candidates; top 10 contains 8 irrelevant and 2 broader
queries.causal_trace: Four generic groups receive the forgiving coverage path because none has strict evidence; catalog-wide administrative health, data, workforce, and workshop language is treated as primary discovery.

queries.causal_trace: A publication-eligible child supplies complete high-temperature composite/hypersonic scope.

queries.causal_trace: The protected AI evidence and complete short-query coverage remove six prior partial matches.

irrelevant_top_ten_cluster.assignment_policy: Each irrelevant admission is assigned once to its dominant observed cause; several have additional secondary causes in the per-query table.

cross_domain_anchor_source_findings.363582: Source exists in parent title/description: maternity and obstetrics care access in rural areas. Failure is normalization and bounded scope entailment, not ingestion.
cross_domain_anchor_source_findings.360205: Official parent/source evidence contains plant production, plant breeding/genetics, traits, and biotic/abiotic stress. The useful detailed children are review-only and must not be displayed. Failure is controlled relationship plus parent-source scope representation.
cross_domain_anchor_source_findings.356623: Official parent/source evidence includes energy storage and grid technologies. Project-duration boilerplate causes competitors; the anchor exists but is ranked below weaker evidence.
cross_domain_anchor_source_findings.361526: Publication-eligible children explicitly include Composable and Modular Foundation Models and AI for Adversarial Robustness and Resilience. Failure is parent/child aggregation and evidence ordering, not source coverage.

architecture_conclusion: The common defect is not missing lexical weight. Concise intent is not verified generically, controlled relationships are query-form specific, authoritative scope is an allowlist rather than family containment, discovery and primary admission are conflated, and rich child/scope evidence has no ordering tier ahead of weak lexical score.
